scientific_question: Can detector-specific target-normal score deformation identify the direction and magnitude of a safe operating-point threshold correction without using target anomaly labels?

normal_only_identifiability.direction_detail: no feature reaches |Spearman rho(delta_tau*_SAFE)| >= 0.30 (max |rho| = 0.203 for q99_q95_change); natural sign rules 0.37-0.53 accuracy << trivial B3 detector-only 0.79; dominant direction is LOWER threshold (82/117); natural 'positive shift -> raise' rule is WRONG for PatchCore (23/24) and EfficientAD (19/24)
normal_only_identifiability.correctability_not_fnr_proxy: AUC(fnr_before vs correctable) = 0.494 (near random); correctable correlates with fpr_before (AUC 0.685); median_shift discriminates correctability within high-FNR regime (AUC 0.765)

safety.note: G3 requires mean delta_fnr <= +0.02 AND harmful-unit rate significantly below Always-On; both Always-On and T4 exceed the delta_fnr bound at FULL; at K8 T2 delta_fnr=0.0214 marginally exceeds the bound

detector_dependence.detail: DINOv2 drives benefit (16/39 safe-correctable, FULL mean delta_ba +0.0999 for T2, +0.1075 for T1/T3 at K8); PatchCore 1/39 and EfficientAD 5/39 have minimal safe headroom; any positive claim must be detector-dependent, not detector-agnostic

selectivity_value.note: abstaining T4 reduces harm rate from 0.573 to 0.376 while keeping mean delta_ba >= Always-On; selectivity has safety value but does not alone satisfy G3

ranking_capability_invariance.note: T0-T4 modify only the operating threshold; AUROC/AUPR are unchanged by construction (E_RANKING.csv per-entity AUROC/AUPR identical across candidates); no ranking-capability claim is made

hypothesis_verdicts.H6_SAFE_DEPLOYABLE_ACTUATOR_EXISTS: NOT_SUPPORTED (simple pre-registered actuators T0-T4 do not satisfy the safety gate G3)

terminal_meaning: Target-normal evidence contains identifiable, stable, detector-dependent information about correctability (safe-threshold-correction headroom), but the pre-registered simple analytic actuators (T0-T4) do not yet deliver a SAFE deployable correction: mean delta_fnr exceeds the +0.02 safety bound and harm rate is high. This terminal permits a subsequent actuator-development cycle; it is NOT a route closure and does NOT authorize method development without explicit user authorization.
next_authorization: NONE from this document. A new actuator-development cycle (e.g., detector-aware sign rules, conservative/selective correction with explicit FNR bound, abstention policy) requires explicit user authorization and a new frozen protocol.
